flowchart TB
    internet((Internet)) --> fw1[Firewall A]
    internet --> fw2[Firewall B]
    subgraph dmz [DMZ]
        fw1 --> proxy1[Proxy 1]
        fw2 --> proxy2[Proxy 2]
        proxy1 --> waf[WAF]
        proxy2 --> waf
    end
    subgraph app [Application zone]
        web1[Web 1]
        web2[Web 2]
        web3[Web 3]
        app1[App 1]
        app2[App 2]
        web1 --> app1
        web2 --> app1
        web2 --> app2
        web3 --> app2
    end
    waf --> web1
    waf --> web2
    waf --> web3
    subgraph db [Data zone]
        primary[(Primary DB)] --> replica1[(Replica 1)]
        primary --> replica2[(Replica 2)]
        cache[(Cache)]
    end
    app1 --> primary
    app2 --> primary
    app1 --> cache
    app2 --> cache
    subgraph ops [Operations]
        mon[Monitoring]
        logs[Log shipping]
        backup[Backups]
    end
    app1 --> logs
    app2 --> logs
    primary --> backup
    mon --> web1
    mon --> app1
    mon --> primary
